results_quoted: On 5,000 synthetic test words (TUMMHCD test characters) it reaches a character error rate of 0.25% and a word error rate of 1.62% with the language model (0.37% and 2.32% without). On 100 real handwritten words (one native writer, on a tablet; words it never saw in training): character error rate 3.88%, word error rate 21.00% with the language model (words read right 79.00%, 95% interval 70.02%-85.83%); without it 4.38% and 24.00%.
